answer.summary: Two architecture tests fail on code this PR changes. AssetGroupService.assetGroupsOfAssets makes an intra-class call to the @Transactional assetGroupIdsByAssetId (AssetGroupService.java:331), which bypasses the Spring proxy. The linked-id guard also flags that body-id resolution doesn't use findAllByIdInTenant. These are deterministic rule violations that will repeat on rerun. The Jackson parse error at line 1245 is unrelated noise from a different service.

evidence.quote: Resolve body ids with findAllByIdInTenant(ids, tenantId), as TagRepository does
